item.title: J&K Govt Appoints Station Commander Haft Chinar As Chairman Of Joint Board Of Officers
item.description: JAMMU, Feb 14: The Jammu and Kashmir Government has ordered a partial modification in Government Order No. 1487-JK(GAD) of 2025 dated November 17, 2025, revising the composition of the Joint Board of Officers. As per the fresh order, the Station Commander, Haft Chinar, has been appointed as the Chairman of the Joint Board, replacing Col Q, Headquarters 31 Sub Area, who will now continue as a Member of the Board. item.description: JAMMU, Feb 14: The Jammu and Kashmir Government has issued strict directions to all departments to ensure that appeals, writ petitions, LPAs and SLPs are filed within the prescribed limitation period, observing that many cases were being referred to the Department of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs after expiry of the statutory timeline, leading to delayed filings, poorly drafted condonation applications and even dismissal of cases on limitation grounds. item.title: Posters Against Wanted Terrorists Surface In J&K’s Doda Amid Intensified Operations
item.description: JAMMU, Feb 14: In a stepped-up anti-terror drive, police in Doda district have pasted posters at several strategic locations seeking information about active terrorists, including a Pakistani commander of the banned outfit Jaish-e-Mohammad identified as Saifullah, officials said on Saturday. item.title: IMF chief to visit Sri Lanka amid cyclone recovery efforts
item.description: COLOMBO, Feb 14: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva will visit Sri Lanka for two days from February 16, the global lender announced. item.title: Ixigo to acquire majority stake in Spanish train booking platform Trenes for 11.70 mn euro
item.description: NEW DELHI, Feb 14: Travel aggregator Ixigo’s board has approved the acquisition of a 60 per cent stake in Spain’s second-largest train booking platform Online Travel Solutions (Trenes), for 11.70 million euro (over Rs 125 crore). item.title: Indian student goes missing in US
item.description: NEW YORK, Feb 14: A 22-year-old Indian postgraduate student has gone missing in the US state of California, prompting efforts by authorities to locate him. Saketh Sreenivasaiah, a UC Berkeley student hailing from Karnataka, disappeared on Tuesday, local media reported, quoting the police. His backpack, with his passport and laptop, was found on a doorstep in the Park Hills neighbourhood, The Berkeley Scanner news portal reported. item.title: Tribute Paid To Pulwama Attack Heroes In Jammu And Kashmir
item.description: SRINAGAR, Feb 14: A wreath-laying ceremony was held at Lethpora in Pulwama on Saturday to pay tribute to 40 CRPF personnel who lost their lives in the 2019 Pulwama terror attack. Senior officials of the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF), civil administration, and security forces paid tributes to the jawans.
